summary: Tested whether VIP calendar bookings (vip_sched) also lock the normal calendar, on the backend (pytest, 17 tests, 16 passed) and the frontend (Playwright). Working: /profiles/{id}/availability busy_slots shows VIP calendar bookings for both the VIP and the client with a ±15 min buffer. Pending bookings and pending proposals are locked too, cancelled bookings are not, and times are converted from Paris to Toronto. Invites, regular bookings and regular reschedules that overlap a booking or its buffer get SLOT_BUSY, for both the VIP and the client. A start exactly at end+15, or a date ending exactly at lock_from, is allowed. On the VIP calendar side, taken shows the booking once with lock_from/lock_to plus normal dates as status 'date'. Booking inside a buffer or a normal-date lock returns 409 SLOT_TAKEN. Rescheduling a confirmed booking does not conflict with itself, and a declined booking frees its slot right away. The UI shows lock chips and the note, and the list refreshed after a pending booking was declined. Regression: all 45 iteration 35/37/38 tests pass. One bug: VIP price-list booking (POST /api/vip/book) is never checked against any slot locks.

critical.issue: vip_book() never calls _assert_slot_free, so a VIP price-list booking at 19:30 inside a VIP calendar booking 19:00-21:00 (lock 18:45-21:15) is accepted (200 escrow) instead of SLOT_BUSY. It also ignores normal dates and cancelled locks. Fix: after computing dur_min/local day, call await _assert_slot_free(target, req.scheduled_at[:10], _hm_to_min(req.scheduled_at[11:16]), _pdt(req.scheduled_at), dur=dur_min or DATE_SLOT_MINUTES).

minor.issue: Only the recipient's calendar is checked. An inviter/booker who has their own VIP calendar booking (as the client) can still create a regular date overlapping it. Reschedule checks both people, but creation does not.

A VIP booking that runs past midnight is stored only on its start date (lock_to > 24:00), so the next local day's calendar doesn't show the spill-over. lock_from is clamped with max(0, ...), so a 00:00 start loses the previous day's 15-min buffer.

action_items: Add the _assert_slot_free check to POST /api/vip/book (VIP price-list booking) so it is rejected with SLOT_BUSY inside VIP calendar locks and normal dates
Optional: also check the inviter/booker's own calendar (busy_only) in POST /api/invites and POST /api/dates/book
